title: Buddy Petit played second voice; no fiddle player
summary: Punch says the trumpet took the lead, Buddy took second voice, and he didn't know Tenette.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about, uh, who played the lead in all them times, too?
Always, huh? Mm-hmm. Just about, unless it was somebody like Buddy sometimes, huh?
Did he ever have a fiddle player with him very much, Buddy?
Let's see, a guy named Tenette used to play with him. Did you know a guy named Tenette?
Tenette. He was a real raggedy fella, and he played real raggedy fiddle.
He might have for I came here. But Buddy was going, you know, when I come to New Orleans, Buddy was going. They didn't be.
